id: title:Gilbert09:don t re report transient object store errors from the idempotency fallback

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the reliability and exception handling strategy for the Temporal workflow implementation, specifically distinguishing transient object-store failures from critical errors to prevent redundant alerting.
review.reason: The change implements a conditional exception reporting strategy by importing and checking against a `NonReportableError` class. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 demonstrate the production implementation: importing the error class and wrapping the exception reporting in a check to exclude transient failures. P1.F2.H1 shows the corresponding test setup. This represents a substantive, bounded,
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that the referenced `NonReportableError` class and its behavior are correctly implemented and complete within the broader dependency chain, which is not fully visible in this chunk. The benefit is the prevention of redundant alerts, not the handling of the transient failure itself.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the `NonReportableError` class or the `_capture_unless_transient` helper, so the reviewer cannot independently verify the classification and suppression logic. The score relies on the assumption that the referenced module and helper exist and behave as described. No score is assigned.

observations.posthog_connection: This class is imported to distinguish transient object-store failures from other errors, supporting the idempotency and exception handling strategy.

observations.behavior: Replaces unconditional `capture_exception(e)` with a conditional check: only report exceptions that are not instances of `NonReportableError`.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents redundant error reporting for transient failures already handled and suppressed by the delta helper, preserving the intended behavior of not alerting on transient blips.

observations.behavior: Adds import of `NonReportableError` in the test file.
